title: You Are Taller in the Morning
hook: Your height is not the same all day, because you are taller in the morning.
script: Your height is not the same all day, because you are taller in the morning. By up to 2 centimetres, which is almost an inch. So where does that height go during the day? The soft spinal discs between your bones get squeezed by your weight. They slowly push out water, so you shrink a little with every hour. Then you lie down, and they soak it back up while you sleep. Is that why astronauts grow taller in space? Without gravity, their discs expand too. So the tape measure says one thing at breakfast and another at bedtime.
